title: Live Collaborative To-Do List
description: A full-stack, real-time, collaborative to-do list application built with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) and TypeScript. Features live updates via WebSockets and user authentication.

title: PassMan - Password Manager
description: A secure, client-side encrypted password manager built with React and Supabase, offering a modern UI and full CRUD functionality.

title: NES Emulator from Scratch
description: A cycle-accurate NES emulator built in C++ from the ground up, capable of playing classic titles like Super Mario Bros.

title: Anime Tracker Flutter App
description: A cross-platform app using MyAnimeList API that allows users to browse, track, and manage anime watchlists with offline access.

title: Fixed Wing Drone
description: A fixed-wing drone powered by ESP12 and MPU6050, featuring built-in stabilization for smooth flight. Controlled wirelessly via WiFi for seamless operation.

title: Quadcopter Drone
description: A compact quadcopter drone powered by ESP32, featuring MPU6050 and BMP280 sensors, multiple flight modes, and WiFi control. Includes USB-C charging and a built-in BMS for enhanced safety.

title: A9G GPS to SMS MicroPython Script
description: A9G GPS to SMS is a MicroPython script for the Ai-Thinker A9G module that sends GPS coordinates via SMS every minute using a Google Maps link for easy tracking.

title: Embedded C Firmware for Satellite Camera Background Subtraction
description: a median-based background subtraction algorithm optimized for AMD-Xilinx FPGA/SoC platforms, designed to process high-resolution satellite imagery in real-time for foreground object detection.
